title: Canonical comparison for the pro-etale stratum internal Hom
statement:
For a finite commutative coefficient ring A and a locally closed immersion s = j i into a Noetherian pro-etale scheme X, the K-flat/K-injective tensor-Hom, projection, and adjunction construction yields a natural transformation from

`RHom_X(Rs_!(-), -)`

to `Rs_* RHom_S(-, Rs^!(-))`; every component of this canonical transformation is an isomorphism. The final packaging as a natural isomorphism is performed by the parent node.

proof.text: Transport the ringed open/closed localization adjunction through the canonical coefficient isomorphisms. Closed direct image is exact with invertible counit, complementary-open pullback vanishes, and closed/open pullbacks jointly reflect isomorphisms. Apply exact derived functors and homology to obtain the same detection and vanishing statements on unbounded derived categories.

Use the native K-flat tensor model and the canonical tensor-pullback comparison. For closed direct image, the inverse-image unit on i_*N tensor K is invertible after both restrictions: on the closed part by the counit and on the complementary open because both objects vanish. Joint detection gives the closed projection isomorphism. This specializes the supported-unit argument already proved in ProEtaleClosedTensorProjection to the actual identified constant coefficient rings.

For open extension, form the inverse projection map by transposing the pullback tensor isomorphism and the invertible open unit. Its closed restriction is a map between zero objects, using disjoint-support vanishing and tensor pullback; its open restriction is invertible by the triangle identity. Joint detection proves it invertible. Compose open and closed projection isomorphisms.

Compose the ambient closed shriek adjunction with the exact open adjunction. Identify the composite constant pullback with pullback along i followed by j, and derive its direct-image adjunction. Turn the native tensor-Hom adjunctions into parametrized adjunctions, using evaluation naturality. Symmetry puts the composite projection formula in the required tensor order. The generic conjugate-isomorphism argument of EtaleGenericStratumMate applies to these pro-etale categories; uncurry and take the isomorphism hom to obtain the asserted natural transformation with all components invertible.

proof_origin.note: Complete proof from existing localization, native tensor-Hom and canonical tensor-pullback declarations. Both support projection arguments and their composition are proved here; no new sorry or public declaration is introduced.
